来 Filoli，最容易犯的错误是只追着照片里的花走。花季会换，真正耐看的还有老: At Filoli, it is easy to chase the flowers in someone else’s photo. Blooms change, but the house’s proportions, garden rooms formed by hedges and the quieter landscape beyond them reward attention in any season. Spending half a day here reveals more than taking one picture before rushing elsewhere.
先选日期，再安排庄园门票: Choose your date before booking estate admission
建议预留 2.5–4 小时。普通门票包含 House、Garden、redwoo: Allow 2.5–4 hours. General admission includes the House, Garden, redwoods and trails, plus parking. Check separate charges for food and special events.
票价、最晚入场和延时开放按日期查看官方日历及售票页面；不要把某晚活动票当作普通日: Check the official calendar and booking page for dated prices, last entry and extended hours. Do not assume an evening-event ticket covers a regular daytime visit.
官方建议所有访客及会员提前订票，按所选一小时窗口签到。周末与花季可能售罄，未订到: Filoli recommends advance tickets for visitors and members, with check-in during the selected one-hour window. Weekends and flowering seasons may sell out; choose another date if needed.

开始 · 老宅与入口片区: Begin: the house and entrance area
从签到处拿地图，按开放安排看老宅；需要避开台阶，先请工作人员指出入屋坡道。不要为: Get a map at check-in and visit the house according to its opening arrangements. Ask staff for the ramp if needed, and keep doorways clear while photographing.
选一条花径慢走，观察花色、树篱与水景，不要求每个花坛都有盛花。坐下休息后，再决定: Follow one garden path, noticing colors, hedges and water features without expecting every bed to be in bloom. Rest before deciding whether to add a woodland walk.
可选延伸 · 开放的红木与步道: Optional extension: open redwood areas and trails
只按当天地图进入开放路线，留足回到入口的时间。步道比庄园提前半小时关闭；体力有限: Use only routes open on the day and leave enough time to return. Trails close half an hour before the estate. If tired, finish in the garden and return to your parking area or pickup point.
导航用 86 Cañada Road, Woodside。开车按工作人员指引停车: Navigate to 86 Cañada Road, Woodside. Follow staff parking directions; rideshare pickup and drop-off are in the main lot area, and a return plan helps. Stairless routes still include brick, gravel and grass, and wheelchairs or walkers are not available to borrow. Regular strollers are welcome; wagons and stroller wagons are not. Use designated picnic tables near the entrance instead of picnicking in the gardens or grounds.
出门前核对车辆、推车与路面: Check transport, strollers and path surfaces before leaving
预订实际日期与时段，保存票据，检查最晚入场和离园时间。: Book the correct date and window, save tickets, and check last entry and closing.
需要无障碍路线时下载专用地图，自备行动辅助设备。: Download the accessible route map if needed and bring your mobility equipment.
拍照只在开放步道上进行；商业或人像拍摄另查许可规则。: Photograph from open paths; check separate rules for commercial or portrait sessions.
